question: In which sport is a "puck" used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ice Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A "**puck**" is a flat, round object made of vulcanized rubber, used in ice hockey games.
 
• The puck is essential for scoring goals, which players hit using their hockey sticks.
 
• Ice hockey is played on **an ice rink**, where players skate to maneuver the puck into the opponent's goal.
 
• The standard puck size is 1 inch thick, 3 inches in diameter, and weighs about 6 ounces (170 grams).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ice Hockey:** A high-speed team sport played on ice, involving two teams with six players each, including a goalie.
 
• **Puck:** The object of play in** ice hockey**, used instead of a ball for faster movement on ice.
 
• **Snooker **uses a cue ball and object balls, table tennis uses a small, **lightweight ball**, and **soccer **uses a spherical **football**.
 
• **Ice hockey** is especially popular in countries like Canada, the **USA**, **Russia**, and parts of **Europe**.
